new.text: **What's new.** The menu lists recent changes, and after an update the app tells you what's new.
**Sets on deck pages.** Each card shows the set symbol and number of the printings you own, so you know which binder to pull it from.
**Group a deck by set.** Switch a deck between By type and By set to gather its cards product by product. The app remembers your choice on this device.

improved.text: **Locked collection covers decks.** While the collection is locked, a saved deck's cards can't be changed. You can still save new decks, and build, deconstruct, rename and print decks.

new.text: **Print queue.** Each proxy PDF you make waits in Print cards until you mark it printed, which adds the cards to your collection. Queued cards aren't asked for again.
**Several decks in one PDF.** Print cards for more than one deck at once, optionally starting each deck on a new page.

improved.text: **Card names match more spellings.** Names with ™, ʼ, curly quotes or ₂ match when typed plainly.
**Pasting deck lists.** Titles starting with a number ("15 Minutes") and counts after the card name now work. Several lists pasted together are split into separate decks.
**Hide rotated** also hides rotated sets from the set picker.
**Locked collection in the print queue.** The "add to collection" button says "Locked: unlock at the top".

fixed.text: Decks without a name show as "Untitled deck" everywhere.
Stats works when you have decks but no cards yet.
Deck names and notes are saved as you type.
When a card is left out of a several-deck PDF, the next deck still starts on a new page.

new.text: **Stats.** Set completion, free cards against cards in decks, breakdowns by faction and type, and a shopping list.
**Find decks on NetrunnerDB.** The Decks page lists published decks ranked by how few cards you'd be missing. Filter by side, faction, Standard or Startup.
**Proxy PDF.** Download a print-ready PDF of the cards a deck is short, laid out like NetrunnerDB's print-and-play sheets, with paper, cut mark and bleed options.
**Browse cards with arrow keys.** In card details, ← and → (or the ‹ › buttons) step through the cards of the page you opened it from.

improved.text: **One row per printing** in the Collection list, with its set symbol and number. Click a column heading to sort by it.
**Add by set works in whole boxes.** Use +/- to add or remove whole boxes of a product. Change single cards in the Collection list.
**Stats: Short for saved decks** opens a list of missing cards you can copy.

fixed.text: Deck lists exported from NetrunnerDB no longer report their summary lines as unrecognised cards.
Adding a deck list no longer adds it twice on a second tap.
